command: cd /work && find crate/src -type f && ls -la && ls crate
cd /work && wc -l crate/src/{proto/streams/*.rs,proto/*.rs,frame/*.rs,hpack/*.rs,codec/*.rs} && cat crate/Cargo.toml && cat crate/src/codec/framed_read.rs
cd /work && find crate/src -name '*.rs' -exec wc -l {} + && cat crate/Cargo.toml && cat crate/src/codec/framed_read.rs

cd /work && cat crate/src/lib.rs && cat crate/tests/h2-support/Cargo.toml && ls crate/tests/h2-tests/tests && cat crate/tests/h2-tests/Cargo.toml && sed -n '1,180p' crate/tests/h2-tests/tests/server.rs && sed -n '1,180p' crate/src/proto/connection.rs
cd /work && cat crate/src/codec/mod.rs && cat crate/src/frame/data.rs && sed -n '1200,1643p' crate/src/server.rs && sed -n '1350,1530p' crate/src/client.rs

cd /work && sed -n '350,650p' crate/src/proto/streams/recv.rs && sed -n '1540,1693p' crate/src/client.rs && cat crate/src/frame/go_away.rs && cat crate/src/proto/settings.rs && cat crate/src/proto/streams/flow_control.rs

cd /work && sed -i 's/futures = "0.3"/futures = { version = "0.3", default-features = false, features = ["std", "async-await"] }/' tmp/audit/Cargo.toml && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 ./run sh -c 'cd /work/tmp/audit && cargo test --offline -- --nocapture'
cd /work && sed -n '150,270p' crate/Cargo.lock && cp crate/Cargo.lock tmp/audit/Cargo.lock && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 ./run sh -c 'cd /work/tmp/audit && cargo test --offline -- --nocapture'
